note: Series are abbreviated to the buckets that matter; the join does not depend on their number. Numbers such as 40.0 are fractional on purpose: a percentage is never rounded to an integer. Expected values are written by hand from the contract's arithmetic.

cases.name: provider usage and list-price input estimates; no allowance needed
a sleeping-host hour next to a measured-zero hour
cases.note: Series abbreviated to three hours. Core lists every bucket: the first hour was read and moved tokens, the second was read and moved none (a measured zero), and nobody read the third (the host slept: no tokens, no coverage), which is no data, never 0. The report passes Core's coveredMs through unchanged so a reader can tell the two apart.
